lemmas.statement: The engine class size 144 equals 9 stake rules times 2 modes times 2 validity members times 2 sealed measure choices times the continuation subsets; the factorization is not fixed by the target, so only the arithmetic 144 = 108 + 36 is stated.
No member of the engine class is initial under inclusion of declarations.

near_misses.claim: A count-minimal member in a declared subclass is unique up to probe-isomorphism.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The target states that none of the minima is unique up to probe-isomorphism; minima_differ_at_genL separates E4 and E1 at the genesis of reading L.

near_misses.claim: Some member is initial under inclusions of declarations.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The target states that no member is initial under inclusion morphisms.

open_obligations: No existing declarations are grounded because SRC is empty, so generators and relations are left empty.
The Lean response relation must be constrained to be a minimum over tied responses.
No theorem ties the finite declaration list to the Engine structure.
The non-isomorphism of minima rests on the Python probe and is not formalized.
The LIVE count of 64 and the TWO-KINDED count of 16 are not reproved.
The detailed factorization of the 144 members, covering the nine stake rules and the capability counts from six to ten, is not given.
